title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, she glides in slow figure-eights through a lantern-lit tank of drifting kelp and sunken teacups, trailing a faint shimmer of bubbles that hum like a distant music box. Every so often she pauses, tilts her shell toward the glass, and spins one slow, graceful pirouette for whoever happens to be watching.
